name: CQLErrorAdaptive
title: CQL Error (Adaptive)
description: Two-stage adaptive Questionnaire for the CQL error scenario. The first $next-question response asks for one manually entered string; once it is answered, the next response adds a read-only summary item whose calculatedExpression is malformed CQL. Used to check that DTR clients recognize problematic CQL in logic that is not used for pre-population, stop requesting further questions, report the error with $log-questionnaire-errors, and prohibit completion of the form.

item.text: Describe the service or equipment being requested.

valueExpression.description: Deliberately malformed CQL concatenation: an unclosed list brace and a dangling + operator. Clients executing CQL must not run it and must report the error.
valueExpression.expression: Combine({'Requested: ', 'see the answer above', ' ') + ' will be reviewed' +
